description.zh: 经典网络连接地址保留天数，取值：**1~120**，单位：天。
description.en: The retention days of the classic network endpoint. Valid values: **1 to 120**. Unit: days.

description.zh:
要延期的经典网络连接地址，经典网络连接地址有两种：
* 经典网络内网地址
* 经典网络读写分离地址
description.en:
The classic network endpoint whose expiration time you want to extend. Two types of classic network endpoints are supported:

*   The internal endpoint of the classic network.
*   The read/write splitting endpoint of the classic network.
The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

title.zh: 修改混访模式下经典网络地址过期时间
